holdout_plan.origin: Sequential monitoring is primary: each holdout observation day is forecast from the previous observation day (the last development day for the first holdout day), with the model updated by every new day. Forecasts made once from the last development day (fixed origin) are secondary.
holdout_plan.units: Calendar episodes: holdout observation days of both directions separated by more than seven days. The holdout holds 13 dates in five episodes, so each decision rests on five independent units.
holdout_plan.decision_rule: Exact one-sided sign test over calendar episodes at the 0.05 level. With five episodes this requires every episode to favour the model (p = 0.031, one chance in 32). Pooled skill and 95% episode-bootstrap intervals are reported as descriptions, not as decision rules.
holdout_plan.power_basis: Chosen on development evidence before any holdout data were read: in the rolling-origin development evaluation the primary model beat persistence in every calendar episode but beat the static fingerprint in about three of four, so with five holdout episodes H1 has high power and H2 low power. The development report gives the episode counts and the implied power.

hypotheses.H1_sequential_vs_persistence: Primary. For the primary indicator, sequential one-step-ahead forecasts of the primary model have a lower mean absolute error than persistence (the last observed daily anomaly). Supported if the skill against persistence is positive in enough calendar episodes for the exact one-sided sign test to give p below 0.05.
hypotheses.H2_sequential_vs_fingerprint: Key secondary. The same comparison and rule against the static development fingerprint (no change since development), which tests for forecastable change in the track response. Development evidence gives this test low power with five episodes.
hypotheses.H3_sequential_ranking: The mean Spearman correlation across bins between sequential forecasts and realised anomalies is positive. Supported if the episode means are positive in enough episodes for the exact one-sided sign test to give p below 0.05.
hypotheses.H4_sequential_calibration: Coverage of the 80% sequential prediction interval of the primary model, pooled over holdout bin-days, lies between 0.70 and 0.90.
hypotheses.H5_fixed_origin_vs_fingerprint: Secondary. Forecasts made once from the last development day beat the static fingerprint, by the same episode sign test. Development evidence suggests this may fail when maintenance or instrument changes intervene.
hypotheses.D1_alarms: Descriptive only: share of tested segments exceeding the frozen development alarm threshold (5% expected without change), with origins at the last development day and at every holdout day, as in development; share of alarms touching the corridor.
hypotheses.D2_secondary: Descriptive only: the same metrics for the secondary indicators and the other models, including the 30-day moving mean, and per-episode results.

development_key_findings: Instrument level regimes (largest change between working regimes): s1 factor 4.9 (2014-07-10 to 2014-08-31); s2 factor 16.9 (2014-07-10 to 2015-06-03); s3 factor 14.9 (2014-07-10 to 2014-08-31); s4 factor 4.9 (2014-07-10 to 2014-08-31); s5 factor 2.1 (2014-11-10 to 2014-12-05).
System-wide change: between 2014-07-10 and 2014-08-31, 4 channels changed level together (s1:0.20 s3:0.07 s4:0.21 s5:0.51; factor = after over before).
Dead or abnormal periods and quality-control pass rate: s1 13 days, 93% pass, s2 54 days, 47% pass, s3 20 days, 85% pass, s4 11 days, 93% pass, s5 9 days, 92% pass.
Fingerprint stability across working regimes (median Spearman): s1 0.65, s3 0.82, s4 0.83, s5 0.68.

Classification (outbound, absolute features, kNN): random CV 0.75, grouped by date 0.71, blocked in time 0.70. Time-shifted copies of the real labels: median 0.77 over 99 shifts (real labels at the 42nd percentile). Placebo blocks of the real sizes: scattered median 0.91, adjacent median 0.72. Chance 0.25.

Classification (outbound, regime-robust relative features, shrinkage LDA): random CV 0.74, grouped by date 0.69, blocked in time 0.67; time-shifted copies median 0.60 (real labels at the 99th percentile, random cross-validation only).

Classification (inbound, absolute features, kNN): random CV 0.78, grouped by date 0.74, blocked in time 0.72. Time-shifted copies of the real labels: median 0.73 over 92 shifts (real labels at the 72nd percentile). Placebo blocks of the real sizes: scattered median 0.90, adjacent median 0.71. Chance 0.25.

Classification (inbound, regime-robust relative features, shrinkage LDA): random CV 0.80, grouped by date 0.69, blocked in time 0.65; time-shifted copies median 0.64 (real labels at the 96th percentile, random cross-validation only).

Forecasting s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz with local_level, next observation day: skill against persistence 0.25 (0.21 to 0.30), against the static fingerprint 0.27 (0.11 to 0.36); better than persistence in 13 and than the fingerprint in 10 of 13 calendar episodes; 80% interval coverage 0.83.

Forecasting s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz with local_level, at least 30 days ahead: skill against persistence 0.24 (0.17 to 0.29), against the static fingerprint 0.21 (0.04 to 0.31); better than persistence in 12 and than the fingerprint in 9 of 13 calendar episodes; 80% interval coverage 0.85.

Forecasting s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz with local_level, at least 90 days ahead: skill against persistence 0.22 (0.07 to 0.36), against the static fingerprint 0.14 (-0.06 to 0.27); better than persistence in 12 and than the fingerprint in 6 of 13 calendar episodes; 80% interval coverage 0.86.
Ranking of bins 30 or more days ahead (s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz, local_level): mean Spearman 0.57 (0.36 to 0.70); top-decile precision 0.43 against 0.10 by chance.

Holdout-like check inside development data (s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz, local_level, sequential, pooled over four cut dates): skill against the static fingerprint 0.25 (0.04 to 0.37); better in 8 of 11 calendar episodes; 80% interval coverage 0.82.

Holdout-like check inside development data (s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz, local_level, fixed origin, pooled over four cut dates): skill against the static fingerprint 0.12 (-0.18 to 0.27); better in 6 of 11 calendar episodes; 80% interval coverage 0.84.

Holdout-like check by cut date (sequential forecasts, calendar episodes after each cut): 2014-12-31: better than persistence in 4 of 4 episodes and than the fingerprint in 4; 2015-03-31: better than persistence in 4 of 4 episodes and than the fingerprint in 3; 2015-06-30: better than persistence in 5 of 5 episodes and than the fingerprint in 3; 2015-08-31: better than persistence in 3 of 3 episodes and than the fingerprint in 2. A cut with fewer than five episodes cannot reach p below 0.05 by construction.

Estimated power of the holdout decision rule with five episodes (all five must favour the model), from the rolling-origin development episodes: H1 against persistence about 0.83 (model better in 13 of 13 episodes); H2 against the static fingerprint about 0.24 (better in 10 of 13).

Cross-sensor agreement of filtered anomalies (mean Spearman): s3_rms_demeaned with s4_rms_demeaned -0.08, s3_rms_demeaned with s5_rms_demeaned -0.18, s4_rms_demeaned with s5_rms_demeaned 0.72, s1_rms_demeaned with s3_rms_demeaned 0.45, s3_bandpower_0p5_5hz with s4_bandpower_0p5_5hz 0.06, s4_bandpower_0p5_5hz with s5_bandpower_0p5_5hz 0.69, s4_bandpower_5_20hz with s5_bandpower_5_20hz 0.55.

Scheduled work: 27 valid single-indicator tests across the indicator family (no regime change in the window); 10 with a Benjamini-Hochberg q of 0.10 or less, 12 with p below 0.05 (about 1.4 expected by chance), 23 with a relative decrease in the corridor.
Check of the scheduled-work null on clean placebo windows: median root-mean-square z 0.97; the standard error was widened for 50% of the tests.

Multi-channel composite tests for the best-covered records: bandpower_0p5_5hz M0144 inbound (s1 s4 s5) z -1.80, p 0.072, q 0.215, channels disagree in sign; bandpower_0p5_5hz M0032 outbound (s1 s3 s4 s5) z -3.39, p 0.001, q 0.004, channels agree in sign; bandpower_5_20hz M0144 inbound (s1 s4 s5) z -0.61, p 0.542, q 0.697, channels disagree in sign; bandpower_5_20hz M0032 outbound (s1 s3 s4 s5) z -0.13, p 0.893, q 0.893, channels disagree in sign; rms_demeaned M0144 inbound (s1 s4 s5) z -0.55, p 0.580, q 0.697, channels disagree in sign; rms_demeaned M0032 outbound (s1 s3 s4 s5) z -1.36, p 0.173, q 0.345, channels agree in sign.

Window sensitivity, 0.5 to 5 Hz composite: M0032 outbound 30 days z -3.39 (p 0.001, signs agree); M0032 outbound 45 days z -2.76 (p 0.006, signs agree); M0144 inbound 20 days z -0.67 (p 0.502, signs mixed); M0144 inbound 30 days z -1.80 (p 0.072, signs mixed); M0144 inbound 45 days z -2.50 (p 0.013, signs mixed).
Detection limit (s45_bandpower_0p5_5hz, 500 m, 3 days after the change, 5% alarm burden): about +36% or -27% in amplitude for 80% detection.
Priority list: 21 bins have a probability above 0.5 of exceeding +22% in amplitude 30 days after the last development day.
